integrity: All source programs, required complete atlas data and real numerical outputs are embedded and hashed. All earlier published partial-family formulas are attributed.
scientific_limitations: Exact enumeration proves only seven- and eight-vertex connected simple graphs; the eight-vertex completeness relies on the published exhaustive Graph Atlas through order seven, embedded in the package. Bibliographic priority may remain imperfectly resolved. No independent mathematical audit was performed.
title: The first global geodesic-subpath maximizers beyond six vertices
